## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on creating an *Editor Manual* for Plone 7. Currently, no comprehensive guide exists, leaving users to rely on outdated Plone 5 documentation. The aim is to develop an up-to-date manual that complements written guidance with automated visuals (screenshots and videos) to make learning easier, especially for non-native English speakers.

## What needs to be done
We propose investigating automated tools like Cypress and Playwright for capturing visuals to supplement the manual. Deliverables include automating visual content updates with each merged pull request and adapting existing Plone 5 documentation for Plone 6 and 7.

## Helpful background
There's a strong consensus that visual aids, while useful, should not replace detailed written instructions. Challenges include the technical complexity of automation and the need for accurate updates. Uncertainties remain on the use of various tools, as different discussions and proposals have emerged without clear resolution.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with tools like [Cypress](https://docs.cypress.io/app/guides/cypress-studio) and [Playwright](https://playwright.dev/docs/codegen).
2. Explore the existing Volto user training at [Plone Training](https://training.plone.org/content-editing/index.html) for potential content reuse.
3. Join discussions at upcoming events to refine the proposal and align efforts within the community.
